newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Resolute mulling Mt Rawdon gold options.
newsitem.headline: Resolute mulling Mt Rawdon gold options.

text.p: Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Thursday it would review options for the development of the Mt Rawdon gold project in Queensland after joint venturer Placer Pacific Ltd decided not to proceed.
Placer Pacific, which holds 70 percent of the joint venture, said the Mt Rawdon deposit, projected to produce 68,000 ounces of gold a year for seven years, did not meet its size criteria.
Managing director Dick Zandee said Placer would consider the options available for its interest.
Placer Pacific's Canadian parent Placer Dome Inc is in the process of mopping up the remaining shares in its Australian subsidiary after a successful takeover bid.
Resolute and Samson Minerals NL each hold 15 percent of the Mt Rawdon project, which is located near the coastal town of Bundaberg.
Resolute said in a statement it would review the project's feasibility study and assess alternatives under the joint venture arrangements to develop the project.
